headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated revenue across Systems, Software Maintenance & Support, and Operation Services.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated Revenue ($M): Symbotic generated $720.84M in Q3 FY26 (+21.7% YoY vs $592.12M; $618.46M in Q4 FY25). Management guided Q4 FY26 to $760M–$780M; Street consensus sits at $774.38M (+25.2% YoY), while buy-side whisper targets $785M+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA excluding SBC, restructuring, and transaction integration items.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Adjusted EBITDA ($M): Reached $95.0M in Q3 FY26 (13.2% margin, more than double $45M YoY). Q4 FY26 management guidance is $100M–$105M; buy-side whisper demands $108M+ to prove operating leverage above the 13.5% margin ceiling.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Adjusted diluted EPS excluding stock-based compensation and Up-C non-controlling tax adjustments.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Adjusted Diluted EPS ($/sh): Q3 FY26 printed $0.41 (+218.5% surprise vs $0.13 est). Street consensus for Q4 FY26E sits at $0.16/sh; whisper expects $0.35+ given 100% 4Q beat rate (+385.6% avg surprise).

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Remaining performance obligations under binding automation master agreements plus the Oct 29, 2026 $6.0B Walmart Commercial Agreement.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Contracted Backlog: Stood at $22.5B at Q3 FY26 close. On Oct 29, 2026, Walmart signed a new Enterprise Master Automation Agreement ($6.0B initial spend incl. $125M R&D DPA) expected to add up to $6.92B in future backlog (~$29.4B pro-forma).

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Active customer warehouse deployments currently in installation vs live commercial operation.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: System Deployments: Symbotic ended Q3 FY26 with 77 systems in deployment (11 new starts) and 56 operational systems. Bulls want 82+ systems in deployment and >=60 operational systems to drive recurring Software & Ops Services.
